The '''Voktunma system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voktunma]]. It was controlled by [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Bregius Golthan]], who guarded the system with three [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and numerous other military support craft.
